name: tests-75pct-polyfactory-model-native-instance-evolution
instr:
polyfactory cannot derive a new model from a native instance while selectively preserving, regenerating, omitting, or replacing fields. Implement direct, nested, and coverage evolution without changing the source.

Use factory-facing field names. Overrides outrank regeneration, which outranks preservation; ordinary factory declarations keep their meaning. Reject unknown, conflicting, read-only, and incompatible requests deterministically with `EvolutionError`, identifying the field and path when applicable.

Return a distinct model and a report with exactly one correctly classified change per field in stable adapter order. Isolate mutable values and supported nested instances from later mutation and partial generation.

AttrsFactory must honor aliases and init eligibility, reconstruct frozen classes, and retain untouched defaults. ModelFactory must preserve Pydantic aliases and explicit-field state while using its validated or construct-based mode throughout nested evolution. MsgspecFactory must distinguish NODEFAULT from concrete defaults, reconstruct frozen Structs, and preserve untouched values exactly.

SQLAlchemyFactory must handle columns and writable relationships independently, exclude read-only association proxies, preserve instrumentation, and keep mapped instances compatible with existing persistence handlers and protocol ordering. TypedDictFactory must distinguish a missing optional key from a present None value during selective regeneration.

Coverage must vary o
